title: Tenant tables key uniqueness by team: a derived gate, campaign_packs widened
deviations_from_card: Per critic revise: the campaign_packs rebuild is guarded by the PRIMARY KEY shape (PRAGMA table_info pk columns), not column presence, so it re-widens a restored old-key dump too; the reverse rebuild ships as exported narrowCampaignPacksKey(db) and rollback-drill.test.ts EXECUTES it (widen -> second team's row -> legacy ON CONFLICT(job_id, lang) proven to throw -> narrow keeps 2/drops 1 -> older image's upsert writes -> re-widen). campaign_packs also added to V0_1_X_SHAPE/V0_1_X_WRITES. Rediscovery half kept but reframed: the cross-team collision is unreachable through buildCandidatePool (stated in store test + doc); the swap is DROP INDEX IF EXISTS ux_rediscovery_alert + new ux_rediscovery_alert_team (workspace_id, job_id, candidate_id), created after the workspace_id ALTER. Fresh DBs now CREATE campaign_packs with the wide key directly (the legacy ALTER becomes a tolerated duplicate-column no-op). The gate's allowlist is explicit per key (identity/minted ids, capability tokens, child keys, decision_config's org-tier partial index) rather than a name rule; a second test fails on stale allowlist entries. Lazy tables are replayed from their store's DDL literals in a :memory: DB (SQL -- comments stripped, quoted ${} defaults substituted). Acceptance 2 (pure checker negative fixture) was green on write since the checker is new, hence 7 red of 8.
notes: Migration run against an online-backup COPY of data/kp.sqlite (scratchpad db-org-users-channels--B): campaign_packs 0 -> 0 rows, PK (job_id,lang) -> (job_id,lang,workspace_id); with 6 planted legacy packs 6 -> 6 rows; rediscovery_alerts 15 -> 15 rows, ux_rediscovery_alert(job_id,candidate_id) -> ux_rediscovery_alert_team(workspace_id,job_id,candidate_id); second boot a no-op. tsc: exit 1 but every error is under the untracked kpi-sim/ directory (foreign); zero errors in tracked paths. test:perf: raised page/llm-config/job-ingest/api route group + all overrides by +4 KB (my measured share: core.ts +3580 B, rediscovery store +699 B; page 8849 -> 8853 with only my files swapped). page.tsx remains 1 KB over (8853 vs 8852) because the base WITHOUT my files already measured 8849 vs the 8848 ceiling after ce1dc2717 (shell-simulation-engine) landed past its own raise - integration must settle that 1 KB. test:unit: green on first full run (pre-trim core.ts); final re-run exit 1 solely on a FLAKE in app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts (process-tree kill; passed on re-run; unrelated). Downgrade note: an older image's rediscovery store re-creates ux_rediscovery_alert(job_id,candidate_id); that only fails if cross-team duplicate pairs exist, which buildCandidatePool cannot produce.
